instruction: A crisp action photograph with a full, eye-level shot captures an indoor boxing gym with concrete walls and yellow accents. On the left, the man in the orange beanie (R1), wearing a white t-shirt and blue sweatpants, stands holding a black heavy punching bag steady with both hands. On the right, the blonde woman in the purple hoodie (R2), wearing black leggings and brown boxing gloves, has fully retracted her left arm, holding both gloves up in a defensive guard position. The man watches the bag intently while the blonde woman maintains her boxing stance. Bright, even indoor lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the floor.
elements: R1 holds the heavy punching bag steady with both hands rather than striking it
R2 is the boxer in guard position rather than the person steadying the bag
R1 watches and stabilizes the bag while R2 maintains the fighting stance
R2 has both boxing gloves raised in a defensive guard
a black heavy punching bag is present and being held steady
brown boxing gloves are worn by R2
the scene is an indoor boxing gym
